**PotentialPatina 1.0.2**, the first public release.

A retro-colour insert effect: vinyl and tape noise, wobble, drive, bit-crush, tone and room, all set with one MAGNITUDE knob and nine subtle presets. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina#readme) for details and limitations.

**Download** `PotentialPatina-1.0.2-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpatina/issues/new/choose).
